deployments_detail.use: "Assia" — AI-based virtual assistant (chatbot) for customer relations, launched Sept 2025, billed as first AI insurance assistant in Morocco

"Assia" AI virtual assistant deployed 24/7 on the AtlantaSanad website (launched 18 Sep 2025), presented as Morocco's first AI insurance assistant. Guides policyholders through claims declaration, post-accident (amicable report) steps, required documents, contract/guarantee explanations, subscription advice, and savings/retirement buyback options in real time. In production on atlantasanad.ma ("Assia, votre conseillère virtuelle"). [not disclosed]

AI-powered conversational chatbot integrated into instant-messaging apps (WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram) and the website chat, launched July 2023. Uses AI to simulate human conversations and lets clients request quotes, declare claims, and track claim files for auto, complementary health and multi-risk home products. Confirmed live and referenced in the 2025 annual report as an existing deployment preceding Assia; WhatsApp channel 06 10 400 400 active. [not disclosed]

Enterprise AI upskilling for staff — "Artificial Intelligence for Business Users" and related Data/AI training (incl. certified Data Protection Officer program), delivered in 2025 partly via the Holmarcom group's AI Institute. Listed in the 2025 annual report under Transformation Digitale & Data as programs that ran, to embed AI/ML and data-protection competencies across business teams. [Holmarcom AI Institute]

Machine learning applied to Life and Non-Life actuarial work ("Machine Learning pour l'Actuariat Vie et Non Vie"), run in 2025 as part of the company's Transformation Digitale & Data training/capability program to build predictive actuarial modeling skills. Documented in the 2025 annual financial report as a delivered program; described as capability-building rather than a named production model. [not disclosed]
